findings.statement: Nwando Achebe's The Female King of Colonial Nigeria was published in February 2011.
The book The Female King of Colonial Nigeria presents the history of Ahebi Ugbabe, an Igbo woman who became king in colonial Nigeria.
According to the description, Ahebi Ugbabe was exiled from Igboland, became a prostitute, traveled widely, and learned to speak many languages.
